```{r}
NNNSDATA<-read.csv("NNNS_score_data.csv")
dim(NNNSDATA)

NNNSDATA<-dplyr::select(NNNSDATA,-c(Pre.Op.NNNS.habituation.score,Post.Op.NNNS.habituation.score))%>%filter(Date.PO.feeds.started !="")%>%filter(Date.Reaching.Full.PO !="" | Date.Identified.as.not.yet.full.PO!="" )


NNNSDATA$Date.PO.feeds.started<-mdy(NNNSDATA$Date.PO.feeds.started)
NNNSDATA$Date.Reaching.Full.PO<-mdy(NNNSDATA$Date.Reaching.Full.PO)
NNNSDATA$Date.Identified.as.not.yet.full.PO<-mdy(NNNSDATA$Date.Identified.as.not.yet.full.PO)



NNNSDATA$Time<-ifelse(is.na(NNNSDATA$Date.Identified.as.not.yet.full.PO),NNNSDATA$Date.Reaching.Full.PO-NNNSDATA$Date.PO.feeds.started,NNNSDATA$Date.Identified.as.not.yet.full.PO-NNNSDATA$Date.PO.feeds.started)
NNNSDATA$Censor<-ifelse(is.na(NNNSDATA$Date.Reaching.Full.PO),1,0)
NNNSDATA<-mutate(NNNSDATA,Inter=Time*Censor)

NNNSDATA$sex..1.M..2.F.<-as.factor(ifelse(NNNSDATA$sex..1.M..2.F.==2,"1","0"))


NNNSDATA<-dplyr::select(NNNSDATA,-c(Date.PO.feeds.started,Date.Reaching.Full.PO,Date.Identified.as.not.yet.full.PO))


View(NNNSDATA)
class(NNNSDATA)
Imputed.data<-mice(NNNSDATA, m=20, maxit = 20, seed = 500)
DATA<-mice::complete(Imputed.data,1)

```


**BETA REGRESSION**

What do we do about 0's and 1's? 

Does this transform work? How would it work with mice?


```{r}
betaresults <- with(Imputed.data, gamlss(ifelse(Percent.of.feeds.taken.by.mouth.at.discharge == 0, 0, Percent.of.feeds.taken.by.mouth.at.discharge*(118 - 1) + .5)/118 ~ sex..1.M..2.F.+Genetic.Syndrome.or.Chromosomal.Abnormality+Age.at.Surgery..days.+Premature+Cardiac.Anatomy+Length.of.intubation..days.+Extubation.failure+GI.Complication+Pre.Op.NNNS.attention.score+Post.Op.NNNS.attention.score, family = BEINF0)
)

betaresults
summary(pool(betaresults)) # Pools results across imputed data sets and adjusts SEs
print(pool(betaresults))

((qnorm(1-0.05/2)+qnorm(1-0.8))^2)/((0.5*0.5)*(1.5/0.9)^2)
```

```{r}
Coxresults <- with(Imputed.data,coxph(Surv(Time,Censor)~ sex..1.M..2.F.+Genetic.Syndrome.or.Chromosomal.Abnormality+Age.at.Surgery..days.+Premature+Cardiac.Anatomy+Length.of.intubation..days.+Extubation.failure+GI.Complication+Pre.Op.NNNS.attention.score+Post.Op.NNNS.attention.score)
)

betaresults
summary(pool(Coxresults)) # Pools results across imputed data sets and adjusts SEs
print(pool(Coxresults))

```

```{r}
#names(dataset)
tab.des=myNOgrtab(xdat=a,typev=tp, dnames=dnamesx, allSums=T, onelinebinary=T, showbinarylevel=T, compact=FALSE, output="Table213.doc", footMissing=T)

kable(tab.des,caption = "Table 1. Descriptive Table",row.names = F)
```

```{r}
Pre<-dplyr::select(NNNSDATA,starts_with("Pre"))[-1]
Post<-dplyr::select(NNNSDATA,starts_with("Post"))
Pre_corr_matrix = cor(Pre,use = "complete.obs")
Post_corr_matrix = cor(Post,use = "complete.obs")
colnames(Pre_corr_matrix)=c('Habituation','Attention','Handling','Qual. Mov.','Regulation', 'Non Opt. Refl.','Stress ','Arousal','Hypertonic','Hypotonic','Asymmetry','Excitability','Lethargy')
rownames(Pre_corr_matrix)=c('Habituation','Attention','Handling','Qual. Mov.','Regulation', 'Non Opt. Refl.','Stress ','Arousal','Hypertonic','Hypotonic','Asymmetry','Excitability','Lethargy')
colnames(Post_corr_matrix)=c('Habituation','Attention','Handling','Qual. Mov.','Regulation', 'Non Opt. Refl.','Stress ','Arousal','Hypertonic','Hypotonic','Asymmetry','Excitability','Lethargy')
rownames(Post_corr_matrix)=c('Habituation','Attention','Handling','Qual. Mov.','Regulation', 'Non Opt. Refl.','Stress ','Arousal','Hypertonic','Hypotonic','Asymmetry','Excitability','Lethargy')
kable(Pre_corr_matrix, caption="Table 3a. Correlation matrix of the pre attention score variables", row.names = T) #rtf didnt work
kable(Post_corr_matrix, caption="Table 3b. Correlation matrix of the pre attention score variables", row.names = T)
```
